commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' Samu Costa (Mallorca) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90+5' The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
90+5' The manager makes a subsitution with Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) coming on for Largie Ramazani.
90+1' David Lopez (Mallorca) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
90+1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.

74' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
73' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stole Dimitrievski, who smothers the ball.

69' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) drives a shot towards the left side of the goal from inside the box, but Stole Dimitrievski leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
67' 1 - 1 GOAL! Umar Sadiq (Valencia) scores with a header from close range after Javi Guerra headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 1:1.
65' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca).

63' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

62' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee blows his whistle, Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.

60' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) replaces Lucas Beltran.

52' A yellow card is awarded to Guido Rodriguez (Valencia).

48' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
48' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
46' A pass from Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) is intercepted by Leo Roman and the move breaks down.

37' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
36' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

14' Samu Costa (Mallorca) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

13' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.

11' Thierry Rendall (Valencia) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Renzo Saravia comes onto the pitch to replace him.

8' Jose Gaya (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

6' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
4' Pepelu (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
